defs.def: something that is difficult to understand or to explain 神秘的事物；不可理解之事；奥秘

ex.t: 下午7:00 颁奖典礼和野餐

defs.def: a person or thing that is strange and interesting because you do not know much about them or it 常用作形容词

ex.s: However, the reason why the Library Cave was sealed up all those years ago remains a mystery.
ex.t: 然而，藏书洞在那么多年前被封起来的原因至今仍是一个谜。

ex.s: The Mysteries of THE MAYA Intrigued by Maya civilisation from a very young age, 15-year-old Canadian William Gadoury thought he had made an incredible discovery from his study of ancient star charts.
ex.t: 玛雅之谜 从小对玛雅文明着迷的15岁加拿大人威廉\u00b7加杜里认为，他通过研究古代星图获得了一个令人难以置信的发现。

ex.s: Why Maya civilisation collapsed remains a mystery.
ex.t: 玛雅文明为何崩溃仍然是个谜。

ex.s: Its once-great cities fell into ruin, leaving various mysteries for later people to solve.
ex.t: 它曾经伟大的城市沦为废墟，留下各种谜团供后人去解开。

defs.def: the quality of being difficult to understand or to explain, especially when this makes sb/sth seem interesting and exciting 神秘；不可思议；奥秘

ex.s: The solution to the mystery of the monarch’s amazing ability comes at a time when it is in serious trouble.
ex.t: 对帝王蝶惊人能力之谜的解答，出现在它陷入严重困境之时。

defs.def: a story, a film/movie or a play in which crimes and strange events are only explained at the end 疑案小说（或电影、戏剧）
secret religious ceremonies; secret knowledge 秘密的宗教仪式；秘密知识：
a religious belief that cannot be explained or proved in a scientific way （宗教信仰的）奥义，奥秘，奥迹
